name: Punjabi Lassi
ingredients: 2 cups fresh, full-fat yogurt (preferably buffalo milk yogurt)
A pinch of saffron threads, soaked in 1 tablespoon warm milk for 10 minutes
1/4 teaspoon roasted cumin powder (optional, for savory version)
1-2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios for garnish
A pinch of salt (for savory version only)
instructions: 1. In a deep bowl, whisk the yogurt vigorously with a hand whisk until smooth and creamy. Alternatively, use a blender for 1 minute on low speed to avoid over-aeration.
2. Add the ice-cold water and sugar, then whisk again until the sugar dissolves and the lassi turns frothy. If using a blender, pulse 2-3 times.
3. Fold in the crushed cardamom seeds and the saffron milk mixture (reserve a few saffron strands for garnish).
4. For a savory version, replace sugar with salt and add roasted cumin powder; omit saffron and cardamom.
5. Pour into tall glasses over ice cubes, if desired. Garnish with pistachios, almonds, and reserved saffron strands.
6. Serve immediately, preferably with a dollop of malai (cream) on top for richness.
description: A creamy, tangy symphony of cultured yogurt, fragrant cardamom, and a whisper of saffron, cooling the spirit and awakening the senses.
